# tally: specification

`tally` keeps todo lists in one JSON file, `~/.tally.json`.

## Commands

- `tally add <list> <text> [--due YYYY-MM-DD]` adds a todo to a list, creating the list if needed.
- `tally list <list>` prints the list's open todos: those with a due date first, earliest due date first, then those without one.
- `tally done <list> <n>` marks the n-th todo of the list done.

## Plans

Free accounts may keep a limited number of lists; paid accounts have no limit. The product team sets the limit.

## Constraints

- The package has no dependencies, runtime or development. Everything, including the tests, uses only Node's built-in modules.
- Tests live in `test/` and run with `npm test`.

=== src/list.js
'use strict'

// Returns the open todos of a list in display order (docs/spec.md, `tally list`).
function openTodos(list) {
  const open = list.todos.filter((t) => !t.done)
  const dated = open.filter((t) => t.due).sort((a, b) => a.due.localeCompare(b.due))
  const undated = open.filter((t) => !t.due)
  return [...dated, ...undated]
}

module.exports = { openTodos }

results:
Based on the search results, here's what I found about free todo app plans and their project/list limits:

## Todoist
Free users are limited to five active projects, though you can add up to 20 sections per project in the free version. The free tier gives you 5 active personal projects, 5 collaborators per project, 3 filter views, 1 week of activity history, 5 MB file uploads, and 300 active tasks per project.

## TickTick
The free tier caps you at 9 lists with 99 tasks each.

## Microsoft To Do
Microsoft To Do offers unlimited lists and members on its free plan, with invitation per list. Everything you get is available on the one single, free, account.

## Quire
The free plan covers up to 10 members, 4 projects and 1,000 tasks per project, including built-in chat.

## Trello
The free plan is workable for small groups: 10 collaborators per workspace, up to 10 boards, and unlimited cards.

## Google Tasks
Google Tasks is completely free for any person with a Google account with no project limits mentioned.
